1.zh: 作　神和主耶稣基督仆人的雅各请散住十二个支派之人的安。
1.en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

1.zh: 我的弟兄们，你们落在百般试炼中，都要以为大喜乐；
1.en: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

1.zh: 因为知道你们的信心经过试验，就生忍耐。
1.en: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

1.zh: 但忍耐也当成功，使你们成全、完备，毫无缺欠。
1.en: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

1.zh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的　神，[主]就必赐给他。
1.en: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

1.zh: 只要凭着信心求，一点不疑惑；因为那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被风吹动翻腾。
1.en: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

1.zh: 这样的人不要想从主那里得什么。
1.en: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

1.zh: 心怀二意的人，在他一切所行的路上都没有定见。
1.en: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

1.zh: 卑微的弟兄升高，就该喜乐；
1.en: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

1.zh: 富足的降卑，也该如此；因为他必要过去，如同草上的花一样。
1.en: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

1.zh: 太阳出来，热风刮起，草就枯干，花也凋谢，美容就消没了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要这样衰残。
1.en: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

1.zh: 忍受试探的人是有福的，因为他经过试验以后，必得生命的冠冕；这是[主]应许给那些爱他之人的。
1.en: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

1.zh: 人被试探，不可说：「我是被　神试探」；因为　神不能被恶试探，他也不试探人。
1.en: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

1.zh: 但各人被试探，乃是被自己的私欲牵引诱惑的。
1.en: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

1.zh: 私欲既怀了胎，就生出罪来；罪既长成，就生出死来。
1.en: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

1.zh: 我亲爱的弟兄们，不要看错了。
1.en: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

1.zh: 各样美善的恩赐和各样全备的赏赐都是从上头来的，从众光之父那里降下来的；在他并没有改变，也没有转动的影儿。
1.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

1.zh: 他按自己的旨意，用真道生了我们，叫我们在他所造的万物中好像初熟的果子。
1.en: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

1.zh: 我亲爱的弟兄们，这是你们所知道的。但你们各人要快快地听，慢慢地说，慢慢地动怒，
1.en: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

1.zh: 因为人的怒气并不成就　神的义。
1.en: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

1.zh: 所以，你们要脱去一切的污秽和盈余的邪恶，存温柔的心领受那所栽种的道，就是能救你们灵魂的道。
1.en: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

1.zh: 只是你们要行道，不要单单听道，自己欺哄自己。
1.en: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

1.zh: 因为听道而不行道的，就像人对着镜子看自己本来的面目，
1.en: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

1.zh: 看见，走后，随即忘了他的相貌如何。
1.en: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

1.zh: 惟有详细察看那全备、[使人]自由之律法的，并且时常如此，这人既不是听了就忘，乃是实在行出来，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
1.en: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

1.zh: 若有人自以为虔诚，却不勒住他的舌头，反欺哄自己的心，这人的虔诚是虚的。
1.en: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

1.zh: 在　神我们的父面前，那清洁没有玷污的虔诚，就是看顾在患难中的孤儿寡妇，并且保守自己不沾染世俗。
1.en: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

2.zh: 我的弟兄们，你们信奉我们荣耀的主耶稣基督，便不可按着外貌待人。
2.en: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

2.zh: 若有一个人带着金戒指，穿着华美衣服，进你们的会堂去；又有一个穷人穿着肮脏衣服也进去；
2.en: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

2.zh: 你们就重看那穿华美衣服的人，说：「请坐在这好位上」；又对那穷人说：「你站在那里」，或「坐在我脚凳下边。」
2.en: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

2.zh: 这岂不是你们偏心待人，用恶意断定人吗？
2.en: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

2.zh: 我亲爱的弟兄们，请听，　神岂不是拣选了世上的贫穷人，叫他们在信上富足，并承受他所应许给那些爱他之人的国吗？
2.en: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

2.zh: 你们反倒羞辱贫穷人。那富足人岂不是欺压你们、拉你们到公堂去吗？
2.en: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

2.zh: 他们不是亵渎你们所敬奉的尊名吗？
2.en: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

2.zh: 经上记着说：「要爱人如己。」你们若全守这至尊的律法才是好的。
2.en: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

2.zh: 但你们若按外貌待人，便是犯罪，被律法定为犯法的。
2.en: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

2.zh: 因为凡遵守全律法的，只在一条上跌倒，他就是犯了众条。
2.en: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

2.zh: 原来那说「不可奸淫」的，也说「不可杀人」；你就是不奸淫，却杀人，仍是成了犯律法的。
2.en: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

2.zh: 你们既然要按[使人]自由的律法受审判，就该照这律法说话行事。
2.en: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

2.zh: 因为那不怜悯人的，也要受无怜悯的审判；怜悯原是向审判夸胜。
2.en: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

2.zh: 我的弟兄们，若有人说自己有信心，却没有行为，有什么益处呢？这信心能救他吗？
2.en: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

2.zh: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露体，又缺了日用的饮食；
2.en: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

2.zh: 你们中间有人对他们说：「平平安安地去吧！愿你们穿得暖，吃得饱」，却不给他们身体所需用的，这有什么益处呢？
2.en: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

2.zh: 这样，信心若没有行为就是死的。
2.en: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

2.zh: 必有人说：「你有信心，我有行为；你将你没有行为的信心指给我看，我便借着我的行为，将我的信心指给你看。」
2.en: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

2.zh: 你信　神只有一位，你信的不错；鬼魔也信，却是战惊。
2.en: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

2.zh: 虚浮的人哪，你愿意知道没有行为的信心是死的吗？
2.en: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

2.zh: 我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕把他儿子以撒献在坛上，岂不是因行为称义吗？
2.en: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

2.zh: 可见，信心是与他的行为并行，而且信心因着行为才得成全。
2.en: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

2.zh: 这就应验经上所说：「亚伯拉罕信　神，这就算为他的义。」他又得称为　神的朋友。
2.en: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

2.zh: 这样看来，人称义是因着行为，不是单因着信。
2.en: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

2.zh: 妓女喇合接待使者，又放他们从别的路上出去，不也是一样因行为称义吗？
2.en: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

2.zh: 身体没有灵魂是死的，信心没有行为也是死的。
2.en: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

3.zh: 我的弟兄们，不要多人作师傅，因为晓得我们要受更重的判断。
3.en: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

3.zh: 原来我们在许多事上都有过失；若有人在话语上没有过失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。
3.en: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

3.zh: 我们若把嚼环放在马嘴里，叫它顺服，就能调动它的全身。
3.en: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

3.zh: 看哪，船只虽然甚大，又被大风催逼，只用小小的舵，就随着掌舵的意思转动。
3.en: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

3.zh: 这样，舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。 看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。
3.en: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

3.zh: 舌头就是火，在我们百体中，舌头是个罪恶的世界，能污秽全身，也能把生命的轮子点起来，并且是从地狱里点着的。
3.en: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

3.zh: 各类的走兽、飞禽、昆虫、水族，本来都可以制伏，也已经被人制伏了；
3.en: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

3.zh: 惟独舌头没有人能制伏，是不止息的恶物，满了害死人的毒气。
3.en: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

3.zh: 我们用舌头颂赞那为主、为父的，又用舌头咒诅那照着　神形象被造的人。
3.en: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

3.zh: 颂赞和咒诅从一个口里出来！我的弟兄们，这是不应当的！
3.en: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

3.zh: 泉源从一个眼里能发出甜苦两样的水吗？
3.en: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

3.zh: 我的弟兄们，无花果树能生橄榄吗？葡萄树能结无花果吗？咸水里也不能发出甜水来。
3.en: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

3.zh: 你们中间谁是有智慧有见识的呢？他就当在智慧的温柔上显出他的善行来。
3.en: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

3.zh: 你们心里若怀着苦毒的嫉妒和纷争，就不可自夸，也不可说谎话抵挡真道。
3.en: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

3.zh: 这样的智慧不是从上头来的，乃是属地的，属情欲的，属鬼魔的。
3.en: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

3.zh: 在何处有嫉妒、纷争，就在何处有扰乱和各样的坏事。
3.en: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

3.zh: 惟独从上头来的智慧，先是清洁，后是和平，温良柔顺，满有怜悯，多结善果，没有偏见，没有假冒。
3.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

3.zh: 并且使人和平的，是用和平所栽种的义果。
3.en: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

4.zh: 你们中间的争战斗殴是从哪里来的呢？不是从你们百体中战斗之私欲来的吗？
4.en: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

4.zh: 你们贪恋，还是得不着；你们杀害嫉妒，又斗殴争战，也不能得。你们得不着，是因为你们不求。
4.en: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

4.zh: 你们求也得不着，是因为你们妄求，要浪费在你们的宴乐中。
4.en: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

4.zh: 你们这些淫乱的人哪，岂不知与世俗为友就是与　神为敌吗？所以凡想要与世俗为友的，就是与　神为敌了。
4.en: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

4.zh: 你们想经上所说是徒然的吗？　神所赐、住在我们里面的灵，是恋爱至于嫉妒吗？
4.en: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

4.zh: 但他赐更多的恩典，所以经上说： 　神阻挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。
4.en: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

4.zh: 故此，你们要顺服　神。务要抵挡魔鬼，魔鬼就必离开你们逃跑了。
4.en: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

4.zh: 你们亲近　神，　神就必亲近你们。有罪的人哪，要洁净你们的手！心怀二意的人哪，要清洁你们的心！
4.en: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

4.zh: 你们要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，将喜笑变作悲哀，欢乐变作愁闷。
4.en: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

4.zh: 务要在主面前自卑，主就必叫你们升高。
4.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

4.zh: 弟兄们，你们不可彼此批评。人若批评弟兄，论断弟兄，就是批评律法，论断律法。你若论断律法，就不是遵行律法，乃是判断人的。
4.en: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

4.zh: 设立律法和判断人的，只有一位，就是那能救人也能灭人的。你是谁，竟敢论断别人呢？
4.en: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

4.zh: 嗐！你们有话说：「今天明天我们要往某城里去，在那里住一年，做买卖得利。」
4.en: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

4.zh: 其实明天如何，你们还不知道。你们的生命是什么呢？你们原来是一片云雾，出现少时就不见了。
4.en: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

4.zh: 你们只当说：「主若愿意，我们就可以活着，也可以做这事，或做那事。」
4.en: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

4.zh: 现今你们竟以张狂夸口；凡这样夸口都是恶的。
4.en: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

4.zh: 人若知道行善，却不去行，这就是他的罪了。
4.en: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

5.zh: 嗐！你们这些富足人哪，应当哭泣、号咷，因为将有苦难临到你们身上。
5.en: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

5.zh: 你们的财物坏了，衣服也被虫子咬了。
5.en: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

5.zh: 你们的金银都长了锈；那锈要证明你们的不是，又要吃你们的肉，如同火烧。你们在这末世只知积攒钱财。
5.en: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

5.zh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。
5.en: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

5.zh: 你们在世上享美福，好宴乐，当宰杀的日子竟娇养你们的心。
5.en: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

5.zh: 你们定了义人的罪，把他杀害，他也不抵挡你们。
5.en: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

5.zh: 弟兄们哪，你们要忍耐，直到主来。看哪，农夫忍耐等候地里宝贵的出产，直到得了秋雨春雨。
5.en: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

5.zh: 你们也当忍耐，坚固你们的心，因为主来的日子近了。
5.en: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

5.zh: 弟兄们，你们不要彼此埋怨，免得受审判。看哪，审判的[主]站在门前了。
5.en: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

5.zh: 弟兄们，你们要把那先前奉主名说话的众先知当作能受苦能忍耐的榜样。
5.en: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

5.zh: 那先前忍耐的人，我们称他们是有福的。你们听见过约伯的忍耐，也知道主[给他]的结局，明显主是满心怜悯，大有慈悲。
5.en: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

5.zh: 我的弟兄们，最要紧的是不可起誓；不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，无论何誓都不可起。你们说话，是，就说是；不是，就说不是，免得你们落在审判之下。
5.en: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

5.zh: 你们中间有受苦的呢，他就该祷告；有喜乐的呢，他就该歌颂。
5.en: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

5.zh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。
5.en: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

5.zh: 出于信心的祈祷要救那病人，主必叫他起来；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
5.en: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 所以你们要彼此认罪，互相代求，使你们可以得医治。义人祈祷所发的力量是大有功效的。
5.en: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

5.zh: 以利亚与我们是一样性情的人，他恳切祷告，求不要下雨，雨就三年零六个月不下在地上。
5.en: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

5.zh: 他又祷告，天就降下雨来，地也生出土产。
5.en: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

5.zh: 我的弟兄们，你们中间若有失迷真道的，有人使他回转，
5.en: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

5.zh: 这人该知道：叫一个罪人从迷路上转回便是救一个灵魂不死，并且遮盖许多的罪。
5.en: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
